metadata.residency: G/U/S/A32/A16 resident in the producing core's scratchpad
metadata.barriers: none between pointwise stages; the I reduction remains a barrier
metadata.slot_reuse: ping-pong over 2 slots per core for G/U/S/A32, with an explicit dependency on the previous occupant's last reader; A16 is not reused
metadata.remote_read_note: down.* reads A16 chunks resident on other cores; no movement/remote-access contract declared
